title: Shadab's 20-Ball Fifty Sends Falcons Past Knight Riders
short_title: Shadab powers Falcons to stunning win
description: Shadab Khan made an unbeaten 52 from 20 balls as Antigua and Barbuda Falcons chased 166 against Trinbago Knight Riders.
dek: A 76-run unbroken stand with Kusal Perera carried the Falcons home with nine balls remaining.
image_alt: Shadab Khan bats for Antigua and Barbuda Falcons
summary_heading: Shadab changes the game with bat and ball
key_points: Falcons won by five wickets with nine balls remaining.
Shadab Khan made 52 not out from 20 balls and conceded eight runs in four overs.

scorecard.result: Antigua and Barbuda Falcons won by 5 wickets with 9 balls remaining

players_heading: Key players from the Falcons' chase

sections.heading: Falcons slow TKR after a rapid start
paragraphs: Colin Munro and Nicholas Pooran drove TKR to 73 for 1 in the PowerPlay, but the Falcons recovered through spin and regular wickets. The visitors closed on 165 for 6.
Match context is available in the Falcons vs Knight Riders match centre.

sections.heading: Shadab and Perera rescue the chase
paragraphs: Antigua slipped to 92 for 5 before Shadab Khan joined Kusal Perera. Their unbroken partnership added 76 from 33 balls and changed the pressure of the chase.
See the Falcons guide and Knight Riders guide.

sections.heading: Five sixes finish the contest
paragraphs: The match swung in the 18th over when Shadab struck three sixes and the Knight Riders conceded 27 runs. That reduced the equation from 37 off 18 balls to 11 off the final two overs.
Shadab struck two more sixes to complete an unbeaten 52 from 20 balls. The Falcons won with nine deliveries unused after appearing out of the contest at 92 for 5.
The result is reflected on the CPL 2026 points table.
